Is this needed? The code only support one tpm since it is a single unique_ptr
Since TPM is a collection in redfish I will plan to update this patch with std::vector<std::unique_ptr<Tpm>>
set present(false)?
We might not reach here if there's no tpm device. So should we make it as preset(false) ?
Good idea. We can have it default to be false and set it otherwise if TPM record is found.
Acknowledged
What about other specMajor? should version be empty to some other string like unknown?

I m very sorry I couldn't understand could you please help me understand the comment. 
The specMajor field indicates the TPM device specification v1 or v2. 
And the FirmwareVersion1 and FirmwareVersion2 indicates the firmware version of the TPM device on the system. 
This is from `Table 126 – TPM Device (Type 43) structure`
My questions is: what should version be if specMajor != tpmMajorVersion1 && specMajor != tpmMajorVersion2? I think it is an error condition we want to handle gracefully.
not sure we need it be reference for uint8_t, pass by value should be ok.
Done
nit: should this be tpmId also? tpmNum can be confused with "number of tpms"

@zhikui.ren@intel.com could you please review the patch ?
This should return like the other similar code and not continue, otherwise `*num` will invoke undefined behavior.

Addressed the comment. 
Introduced meson option which is disabled by default. When enabled, TPM info is populated on DBUS.

do we consider tmpid in the object ? do we have possibility of more than one tpm records ?

There is a possibility of multiple TPM records. 
Each TPM object will have associated TPM-Id. 
This is required for smbios record parsing to identify the specific TPM record of our interest and populate the properties on dbus.
can we not add dbus ? do we have alternates to keep dbus here ? is it coming from existing pattern ? i am fine its from existing pattern

Yes it is from existing pattern
For exposing dimm information on dbus there is a option as dimm-dbus. 
Followed the same pattern here
